name: Diane Circle former gazebo footprint
summary: Former footprint of a square timber shelter shown beside the P4 garage in older street photos. The 2025 aerial shows a paved strip against the garage in its place.

evidence.note: The 2025 image shows the edge of the garage deck, a narrow strip and vehicle markings on the drive. There is no distinct square pavilion roof.
A square timber shelter with a pitched brown roof stands along the garage wall in 2017.
The setback outside the garage is visible obliquely. The entrance canopy on the opposite side of the drive is a separate structure.
P90 9.81 m and maximum 10.45 m exceed the scale of the small shelter in the 2017 view. Returns on this frontage include garage geometry.

notes: The 2017 shelter is historical evidence only. Garage overhang and image displacement reduce confidence in the precise date of removal.
